mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courier_reviews (courier_id, order_id, user_id, rating, content, tags, create_time) VALUES (#{courierId}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{tags}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM courier_reviews WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM courier_reviews WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT rating as rating, COUNT(*) as count FROM courier_reviews WHERE courier_id = #{courierId} GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating DESC
